text: Good evening. I have my granddaughter Ellie staying with me, she is 5. She has had a temprature this evening, I took it under her arm about half an hour ago and it was 38.6. She was sick once just after tea, I think maybe she ate too fast, but since then she has had several drinks of water and a little milk and kept them all down without any trouble. She also has a few insect bites on her legs from playing in the garden this afternoon, I think they are midges or mosquitos, they are small raised lumps and she keeps scratching at them. I have put some cream on them. Her colour looks normal to me, her lips are pink and her skin looks just like it usually does. I am not overly worried but her mother asked me to check with someone before I give her anything as I am not sure what dose is right for her age. Also is it alright to give medicine when she has been sick? I would rather ask than guess. Thank you.
